title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-002
doc_notes: This document is a collection of source files and reports regarding UFO sightings, primarily focusing on the JAL 1628 incident and various pilot reports compiled by Phenomena Research.

encounters.summary: Japan Airlines flight 1628 crew reported observing two amber lights and a large walnut-shaped object that maneuvered with the aircraft.
encounters.entity_appearance: Two amber lights, cylinders with lateral lines of light, walnut-shaped object twice the size of an aircraft carrier.
encounters.entity_behavior: Hovered, shifted side-to-side, pulsed, moved in formation with the aircraft, circled the plane.
encounters.quote: The objects, Terauchi believes were not made by human kind.

encounters.summary: Pilot of a Cessna reported a torpedo-shaped object passing his aircraft, causing the instrument panel to malfunction.
encounters.entity_appearance: Torpedo-shaped object, size of a Cessna.

encounters.summary: Aeroflot airliner crew observed a glowing object that directed a beam of light to the ground and then paced the aircraft.
encounters.entity_behavior: Directed a bright ray of light to the ground, positioned itself beside the aircraft.

encounters.summary: Pilot and passengers of a small aircraft reported a glowing object that caused the engine to stop and lights to fail.
encounters.entity_appearance: Long, pointed on both ends, glowing.
encounters.entity_behavior: Separated into two parts, glow disappeared, later lunged upward on a highway.

encounters.summary: Pilot of a small airplane reported two hamburger-bun-shaped objects circling his aircraft.
